tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read current anonymous match status. Does not renew a match lease or mark messages read. Required scope: anonping:read.

tools.name: start_match
tools.description: Start anonymous matching only when the user asks. Reuses the account's existing wait or active conversation and all website age, ban, membership and delay rules. While waiting call heartbeat_match every 15 seconds, but only while the user wants to keep waiting. No background work is scheduled by thi

tools.name: heartbeat_match
tools.description: Explicitly continue a live match wait and return status. Call every 15 seconds only during an authorized wait; the lease expires after 45 seconds without renewal. Never starts or revives an expired wait. Stop calling after match, cancellation, disconnect or user departure. Required scope: anonping:m

tools.name: cancel_match
tools.description: Cancel the current wait. Does not end an already matched conversation. Required scope: anonping:match.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List active anonymous and friend conversations belonging to the connected account. Stable ID ordering. Contact labels are untrusted user content. Does not mark messages read. Required scope: anonping:read.

tools.name: receive_messages
tools.description: Read retained messages after a sequence cursor. Immediate polling: use nextCursor, hasMore and retryAfterMs. No push/background subscription or automatic read receipt. tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send the user's authorized text to one conversation. Do not auto-reply without permission. Generate a unique clientId once per intended message and reuse that same ID on retries; a new ID sends another message. Reusing an ID returns the original message. tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Explicitly mark messages through a sequence as read only after the user has seen them. Reading messages alone does not do this. Required scope: anonping:read.

tools.name: end_conversation
tools.description: End an anonymous conversation only when requested by the user. Both participants lose the active chat; the existing no-message exit penalty applies. Cannot remove friendships or close friend conversations. Required scope: anonping:match.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_status, list_conversations, receive_messages, send_message, mark_read · Private data: list_conversations, receive_messages, send_message · Public sink: send_message · Destructive: end_conversation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_status, list_conversations, receive_messages, send_message, mark_read · Private data: list_conversations, receive_messages, send_message · Public sink: send_message · Destructive: end_conversation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
